title: Phenol-Chloroform DNA Isolation for Environmental DNA (eDNA)
author: Spangler MA
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.hnfb5bn

steps.title: Prepare Filter Membrane
steps.instruction: Shred 1/2 of the filter membrane using a sterilized blade and forceps and place it into a 2 mL sample tube.

substeps.instruction: Store the remaining membrane for future use.

steps.title: Lysis with Buffer ATL
steps.instruction: Add 800 μL Buffer ATL (Qiagen, Catalog #19076) to the 2 mL sample tube containing the shredded filter membrane.

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample tubes at 65°C for 10-15 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Vortex occasionally throughout the incubation period.

steps.title: Perform Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Add 800 μL PCI (one phase 25:24:1, Amresco, Catalog #K169) to the sample tubes.

steps.title: Perform Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer 600 μL of the aqueous DNA layer (top) to a new 1.5 mL sample tube and add 600 μL CI (24:1, Amresco, Catalog #X205).

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer 400 μL of the aqueous DNA layer to a new 1.5 mL sample tube and add 1 mL 100% ice cold ethanol and 16 μL 5M NaCl.

steps.title: Recover DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge sample tubes for 10 minutes at 15,000 g.

substeps.instruction: Decant and dispose of the liquid.

steps.title: Wash DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Add 100 μL 70% room temperature ethanol to the DNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Repeat this wash for samples with high likelihood of PCR inhibition (e.g., discolored/gelatinous pellets or samples from wetlands with high tannins or humic acids).

steps.title: Dry DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Decant and dispose of the liquid, then dry samples in a vacuum heater for 10-15 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Continue to air dry until no visible liquid remains.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Add 100 μL 1x TE Buffer (low EDTA) and incubate at room temperature overnight.
